issue: Strain namespace collision: personal serum track versus expedition survival track; generic condition reference currently names expedition Strain without explicitly identifying Warrior Strain. No merge has been authorized.

warriorEngine.text: STRAIN. Begin after a long rest at 0 Strain; maximum Strain is 3. A normal serum injection or Mutagen Injection adds 1 Strain, Mutation Surge adds 1, and Serum Cocktail or Mutation Overload adds 2 unless modified. At Strain 2 your Speed is reduced by 5 feet. At Strain 3 you also take -1 AC and -1 on saving throws and cannot voluntarily activate another serum, Cocktail, Overclock or Surge until Strain is reduced. A completed short rest reduces Strain by 1; a long rest resets it to 0. Strain cannot exceed 3.

expeditionReference.text:
### Strain

Strain represents exhaustion, sleep debt, hunger, exposure, and sustained magical stress.

| Strain | Effect |
|---:|---|
| 0 | No penalty |
| 1 | -1 initiative and expedition checks |
| 2 | Speed -10 ft.; -1 attacks and saves |
| 3 | Disadvantage on expedition checks; cannot Dash twice consecutively |
| 4 | Maximum HP reduced by 25% |
| 5 | Incapacitated except for slow travel and Rest |
| 6 | Death or permanent collapse, as appropriate to the cause |

A secure Long Rest removes 1 Strain. Haven care removes all ordinary Strain after one full day. Specific conditions may require treatment.

proposedDisposition: Preserve separate mechanical identities and recovery rules; determine Quickglass, morale care, treatment-failure and serum interactions explicitly with GPT. Never map a Warrior3 cap into expedition6 death or cure one with the other by matching display name.
